title: Manuela Sáenz
summary: Manuela Sáenz was an Ecuadorian revolutionary and patriot who played a crucial military and political role in the South American wars of independence. As the trusted companion and archivist of Simón Bolívar, she participated in campaigns across Gran Colombia and Peru, received the Order of the Sun, and famously thwarted an assassination attempt on Bolívar in 1828, earning the title Liberatress of the Liberator.
